messages.text:
There’s one leftover temp directory from an earlier filesystem probe and a `__pycache__` from syntax checking.

They’re not part of the deliverable, so I’m cleaning those up and leaving just the port, entrypoint, and compile script changes.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$targets = @((Resolve-Path .'"\\__pycache__ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue),(Resolve-Path .\\tmpsiu9vmd1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) | Where-Object { "'$_ }; foreach ($t in $targets) { if ($t.Path.StartsWith((Resolve-Path .).Path)) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $t.Path -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; git status --short'
